{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The traditional patient-doctor relationship must be preserved.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Medical decision-making should be in the hands of physicians and their patients.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In cases when a health plan denies treatment, a rapid appeals process geared toward ensuring that patients receive the right treatment without delays that might threaten a patient's health must be readily accessible to everyone in all health plans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A quick and fair resolution to treatment disputes without going to court is the best result.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As a last resort, a patient's right to adjudicate claims in court to receive necessary medical care is supported.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Employers and physicians should not be liable for the actions of the health plan.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Employers and physicians should be shielded from frivolous and unnecessary lawsuits.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The overall philosophy is to trust state and local government to know what best suits the needs of their people.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The federal government should respect the states' traditional authority to regulate health insurance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The federal government should respect the states' traditional authority to regulate health care professionals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The federal government should respect the states' traditional authority to regulate health practice guidelines through their medical boards.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
